cases.summary: Avatar not loading behind a corporate proxy (HTTP 407 Proxy Authentication Required)
cases.description:
### Environment

- GitExtensions version: 4.2.1
- GIT version: 2.43.2
- OS version: Windows 10 22H2
- .NET version: .NET 6.0.27


### Issue description

Avatars don't load when behind a corporate proxy requiring auth (HTTP 407 Proxy Authentication Required)

### Steps to reproduce

Get behind a corporate proxy
Display avatars, you only get the mystery person and the corporate proxy logs 407 Proxy Authentication Required


### Did this work in previous version of GitExtensions?

Yes, it works at least in v2.51

### Diagnostics

_No response_

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix avatars not loading behind a corporate proxy

<!-- Please read CONTRIBUTING.md before submitting a pull request -->

Fixes https://github.com/gitextensions/gitextensions/issues/11595

## Proposed changes

- Use Default credentials for proxy access when loading avatars

## Test methodology
- Testing before : no avatar displayed when behind corporate proxy
- Testing after : avatar displayed

## Test environment(s)

- GitExtensions version: 4.2.1
- GIT version: 2.43.2
- OS version: Windows 10 22H2
- .NET version: .NET 6.0.27
